description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for fetching Buzz Feed posts within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving the list of posts with optional sorting and pagination, and stubs for create and delete operations that are not implemented. The class uses traits for Buzz service interactions and authentication, and adheres to a specific API structure with validation rules.

classes.name: BuzzFeedAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving, creating, and deleting Buzz Feed posts, with only retrieval implemented.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Buzz Feed posts applying sorting and pagination. Uses BuzzFeedFilterParams for filtering and returns a collection result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, primarily for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method stub for creating a new Buzz Feed post; not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for create operation; not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method stub for deleting a Buzz Feed post; not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation; not implemented.
